headline.hi: Jadoo Ke Formulas Jo Har Proof Mein Kaam Aate Hain!
headline.en: Magic Formulas That Work in Every Proof!

subtext.hi: Identities woh equations hain jo har angle θ ke liye true hoti hain — CBSE exams mein directly 3-4 marks ke questions aate hain.
subtext.en: Identities are equations that are true for every angle θ — CBSE exams directly ask 3-4 mark questions on these.

text.hi: Equation sirf kuch specific values ke liye true hoti hai (jaise 2x=4 sirf x=2 par true hai), lekin Identity har valid value ke liye true hoti hai (jaise sin²θ+cos²θ=1, har θ ke liye). CBSE mein mainly 3 identities padhni hain, aur inhe prove karna aur apply karna dono aana chahiye.
text.en: An equation is true only for specific values (like 2x=4 is true only at x=2), but an Identity is true for every valid value (like sin²θ+cos²θ=1, true for every θ). CBSE mainly covers 3 identities, and you need to be able to both prove and apply them.

explanation.content:
(1) sin²θ + cos²θ = 1
(2) 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ
(3) 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ

content.hi: Proof of Identity (1): Right triangle mein sin θ=P/H, cos θ=B/H. sin²θ+cos²θ = (P²+B²)/H². Pythagoras se P²+B²=H², isliye ye H²/H²=1 ban jaata hai.
content.en: Proof of Identity (1): In a right triangle, sin θ=P/H, cos θ=B/H. sin²θ+cos²θ = (P²+B²)/H². By Pythagoras, P²+B²=H², so this becomes H²/H²=1.

content.hi: Proof of Identity (2): Identity (1) ko cos²θ se divide karo: (sin²θ/cos²θ) + (cos²θ/cos²θ) = 1/cos²θ, jo ban jaata hai tan²θ + 1 = sec²θ.
content.en: Proof of Identity (2): Divide Identity (1) by cos²θ: (sin²θ/cos²θ) + (cos²θ/cos²θ) = 1/cos²θ, which gives tan²θ + 1 = sec²θ.

content.hi: Proof of Identity (3): Identity (1) ko sin²θ se divide karo: (sin²θ/sin²θ) + (cos²θ/sin²θ) = 1/sin²θ, jo ban jaata hai 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.
content.en: Proof of Identity (3): Divide Identity (1) by sin²θ: (sin²θ/sin²θ) + (cos²θ/sin²θ) = 1/sin²θ, which gives 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

content.hi: Proof strategy: har proof mein LHS ko step-by-step simplify karo (sin/cos mein convert karke) jab tak RHS ke barabar na aa jaaye. Bonus: (sin θ ± cos θ)² = 1 ± 2 sin θ cos θ — bahut kaam aata hai!
content.en: Proof strategy: in every proof, simplify the LHS step-by-step (by converting to sin/cos) until it matches the RHS. Bonus: (sin θ ± cos θ)² = 1 ± 2 sin θ cos θ — very useful!

caption.hi: Teeno identities Pythagoras Theorem se hi derive hoti hain — sirf divide karne ka tareeka alag hai.
caption.en: All three identities are derived from the Pythagoras Theorem — only the way you divide differs.

problem.hi: Prove karo: sec θ (1 − sin θ)(sec θ + tan θ) = 1
problem.en: Prove that: sec θ (1 − sin θ)(sec θ + tan θ) = 1

steps.hi: (1−sin θ)(sec θ+tan θ) multiply karo = sec θ+tan θ−sin θ sec θ−sin θ tan θ
steps.en: Multiply (1−sin θ)(sec θ+tan θ) = sec θ+tan θ−sin θ sec θ−sin θ tan θ

steps.hi: sec θ=1/cos θ, tan θ=sin θ/cos θ substitute karo: = 1/cos θ+sin θ/cos θ−sin θ/cos θ−sin²θ/cos θ
steps.en: Substitute sec θ=1/cos θ, tan θ=sin θ/cos θ: = 1/cos θ+sin θ/cos θ−sin θ/cos θ−sin²θ/cos θ

steps.hi: = 1/cos θ − sin²θ/cos θ = (1−sin²θ)/cos θ = cos²θ/cos θ = cos θ
steps.en: = 1/cos θ − sin²θ/cos θ = (1−sin²θ)/cos θ = cos²θ/cos θ = cos θ

steps.hi: LHS = sec θ × cos θ = (1/cos θ) × cos θ = 1 = RHS ✓
steps.en: LHS = sec θ × cos θ = (1/cos θ) × cos θ = 1 = RHS ✓

problem.hi: tan A ko sec A ki terms mein likho.
problem.en: Express tan A in terms of sec A.

problem.hi: Agar sin θ + cos θ = 7/5 hai, toh sin θ cos θ nikaalo.
problem.en: If sin θ + cos θ = 7/5, find sin θ cos θ.

steps.hi: Dono sides ka square karo: (sin θ+cos θ)² = (7/5)²
2 sin θ cos θ = 49/25 − 1 = 24/25 → sin θ cos θ = 12/25
steps.en: 2 sin θ cos θ = 49/25 − 1 = 24/25 → sin θ cos θ = 12/25

explanation.hi: Identity (1) se: sin²θ+cos²θ hamesha 1 hota hai.
Sahi — Identity (3), 1+cot²θ=cosec²θ, ko rearrange karne se milta hai.
explanation.en: True — this comes from rearranging Identity (3), 1+cot²θ=cosec²θ.

question.hi: Agar sin θ = 1/2 hai, toh cos²θ kya hoga?
question.en: If sin θ = 1/2, what is cos²θ?

notes.hi: Identity (1): sin²θ+cos²θ=1 (sabse important, yahi se baaki do derive hoti hain)
notes.en: Identity (1): sin²θ+cos²θ=1 (most important, the other two derive from it)

notes.hi: Proofs mein LHS ko simplify karo, RHS ke barabar lao — (sin θ±cos θ)²=1±2sinθcosθ bahut kaam aata hai
notes.en: In proofs, simplify the LHS to match the RHS — (sin θ±cos θ)²=1±2sinθcosθ is very useful

summary.hi: Ab tumhe teeno trigonometric identities aur unki proofs aati hain, aur inhe apply karke problems solve kar sakte ho. Agle (aakhri) lesson mein hum ye sab concepts board-exam-level important questions mein practice karenge.
summary.en: You now know all three trigonometric identities and their proofs, and can apply them to solve problems. In the next (final) lesson, we'll practice all of this in board-exam-level important questions.
